description: Check one ISO 20022 XML message (pacs.008.001.08, pacs.009.001.08, pacs.002.001.10, pacs.004.001.09, pain.001.001.09, camt.053.001.08, camt.054.001.08 or seev.031.001.14) against the official base schema, then business rules (check digits, totals, cross-element rules, market practice). Returns valid or not, and every problem with its line, element path, stable code and a plain reason. The message type is read from the namespace. The message is checked and not stored. Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/test-bench.

message.description: Check as this message type instead of the one its namespace names (optional).

xml.description: The whole message, as XML text. A <Document> inside an envelope with an AppHdr is fine.

name: validate_message
title: Check an ISO 20022 message
